test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

He is quite ______ and narrow.
solution:
The correct answer is "tall."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **
 

__
 
• The word** "tall"** would fit well in the blank because it contrasts with **"narrow," **suggesting that the person being described has a significant height but is slim or slender in build. (**"Tall"** शब्द रिक्त स्थान में अच्छी तरह से फिट होगा क्योंकि यह **"narrow"** के विपरीत है, जिससे पता चलता है कि जिस व्यक्ति का वर्णन किया जा रहा है उसकी ऊंचाई महत्वपूर्ण है लेकिन वह पतला या पतले शरीर वाला है।)
 
• This creates a vivid image of someone who is physically elongated vertically but not necessarily broad in width.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *He is quite **tall**__ and narrow.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Long: **measuring or covering a large amount in distance or time. (दूरी या समय की बड़ी मात्रा में व्‍याप्‍त, दूर या लंबा)
 
• **Stretched: **to pull something so that it becomes longer or wider; to become longer or wider in this way. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा करने के लिए खींचना; (किसी वस्‍तु का) खिंच कर अधिक लंबा या चौड़ा हो जाना, बढ़ जाना, तनन)
 
• **Elongated: **long and thin. (लंबा और पतला)
